description.p: Prepare an editable script and display a compact reading window near your webcam. Optional local speech recognition follows your words.
Transcribe meeting audio locally and review a question before asking a compatible local or remote language model for a draft. Edit and approve the answer before appending it to your script.
This is a development preview. Speech requires a separately installed Vosk library and model. Capture exclusion requires KDE configuration and is subject to known compositor limitations.
Development version with editable prompting and local speech recognition.
